engine.name: Badlands (pyBadlands)
engine.binary: python package badlands in the pyBadlands venv (python 3.12, numpy<2)
engine.source: inputs: github.com/badlands-model/badlands-workshop examples/mountain (commit 1bfad47aba2554945c5b6b645b10056df91d3bbf, 2023-08-07); engine: github.com/badlands-model/badlands (local source commit a6d7b3aa965cc0047af124310070a57d634b59d9)

simulation.grid: TIN from data/nodes.csv, 16480 nodes, resfactor 1, fixed boundary
simulation.processes: uplift (data/uplift.csv), uniform rain 1 m/a to 15 Myr then orographic rain, erosion-only stream power (m=0.5,n=1,K=5e-6), linear creep 0.8 m2/a
simulation.runtime_s: about 100 on this server, ~165 MB RAM
